cohort: The study analyzed 180 women who attempted Vaginal Birth after Cesarean (VBAC) at a tertiary care center from January 2015 to December 2019.
finding: Mechanical induction methods (Foley catheter) were associated with the highest VBAC success rates and lower maternal complications compared to pharmacological and Oxytocin inductions.
mod_finding: Mechanical induction methods showed higher success rates for vaginal birth after cesarean compared to pharmacological and Oxytocin inductions.
